text:
opsbot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Rate > 1% over 5m. Paging rotation triggered.

maria (oncall): I'm on it. starting with ingress and renderer queues. anyone see related deploys?

eli (support): customer B opened a ticket about bulk job failures at ~11:02 UTC: https://support.example/cases/8721 — looks like retries.

lee (eng-sre): quick dashboard glance: spike at 11:01. p95 latency doubled, renderer queue depth spiked. I'm spinning up extra workers and checking kernel OOM logs.

maria (oncall): scaling renderer pool + enabling emergency rate-limiter to shed extra retries. rolling now.

opsbot: Scale task started by maria: renderer-pool +2 replicas (task id r-7a9c).

anya (observability): adding temporary grafana panel to monitor 5xx by api_key and token_size. Will add an incident dashboard for retro with drilldowns.

lee (eng-sre): update: after scale p95 improved ~20%, but 5xx still noisy. Correlation shows heavy requests with token_count >2500 from a single api_key.

maria (oncall): enabling short-term token-size hard cap at 3000 with 429 if exceeded. Posting client advisory to affected API key owners.

sam (product): flagging that enterprise customers with long-context will receive notice. prepping a template to explain the temporary cap + recommended retry/backoff.

eli (support): pinged customer B. they had a misconfigured retry loop that retried on every 5xx. they're throttling now.

maria (oncall): monitoring window 20m after mitigation. leaving page open.

opsbot: Incident MONITORING: INC-2026-0413-01
